newsitem.title: USA: Mega Group to merge with Capital Access.
newsitem.headline: Mega Group to merge with Capital Access.

text.p: Mega Group Inc, an owner and operator of insurance agencies, said Wednesday it has entered into an agreement to merge its operations with privately held Capital Access Group LLC.
A new public entity would be created and operate under the Capital Access name.
The financial details of the transaction were not made public.

Under a completed deal, Mega Group told Reuters the assets and liabilities of the insurance business would be spun off into a private company expected to be run by a group of Mega shareholders and managers. Nelson Beebe, the chief financial officer of Mega Group, said he believed the newly created private insurance company is expected to operate under the name Mega Group.
Capital Access Group currently operates as a financial advisory firm.
